node.statement: If S_P=0, then M_n tensor S_P={0} for every n, so Z=0 and ||Z^dagger dot Z||=0=(1-K_sq e)||Z||^2; hence the displayed inequality is vacuous. The amended parent deliberately makes no assertion in the remaining formally possible branch P vanishing and S_P nonzero, because no allowed definition or upstream lemma rules that branch out. Consequently the former unconditional statement and the invalid level-one-to-amplified use in node 1.1.2 are withdrawn rather than relied upon.
